exposure: First trimester fasting glucose (FTFG) level (≥ 95 mg/dl vs. < 95 mg/dl)
finding: Women with FTFG ≥ 95 mg/dl had a significantly higher risk of gestational hypertension and diabetes-related complications, even after adjusting for potential confounders.
mod_finding: Women with first trimester fasting glucose levels ≥ 95 mg/dl had higher rates of cesarean delivery.
